LESSON: FLOATING AND SINKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.1: Floating and Sinking

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Floating and Sinking. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Floating and Sinking
2. Practise Floating and Sinking at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Floating and Sinking

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Floating and Sinking
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Floating and Sinking. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Floating and Sinking at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Floating and Sinking at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Floating and Sinking
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Floating and Sinking. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Floating and Sinking using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Floating and Sinking in the examples.
2. Explain Floating and Sinking to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Floating and Sinking.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Floating and Sinking using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Floating and Sinking important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Floating and Sinking
2. Practise Floating and Sinking at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Floating and Sinking

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
